corpus.https://help.example.com/pricing:
Change membership pricing

Go to Admin, Members, Membership Plans. Click the plan name and edit the Monthly Price field, then Save. Existing subscribers keep their old price until renewal.
corpus.https://help.example.com/refunds:
Refund policy

Annual plans can be refunded within 14 days of purchase. Monthly plans can be cancelled any time but the current month is not refunded. Contact support with your invoice number.
corpus.https://help.example.com/domain:
Connect a custom domain

In Admin open Settings then Domains. Add your domain, then create a CNAME record at your registrar pointing to sites.example.com. Propagation can take up to 48 hours.
corpus.https://help.example.com/languages:
Add a language

Open Admin, Settings, Languages. Choose Add Language, pick Spanish or French, and publish. Menu labels are translated automatically.
corpus.https://help.example.com/email:
Edit the welcome email

Open Admin, Emails, Templates. Select Welcome Email and edit the subject and body. Use the placeholder %member_name% to insert the name.
corpus.https://help.example.com/export:
Export members

Open Admin, Members, then Export. Choose CSV and the columns you want. The file is emailed to you when ready.
corpus.https://help.example.com/2fa:
Two-factor authentication

Turn on 2FA under My Account, Security. If you lose your phone use one of the ten backup codes shown at setup.
corpus.https://help.example.com/stripe:
Accept payments with Stripe

Open Admin, Payments, Gateways. Choose Stripe, paste your publishable and secret keys, and enable Live Mode.
